layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for task tags
Record request to verify after implementation

graderOnly: All three approved steps (DEV-001, DEV-002, DEV-003) are DONE with satisfactory recorded self-checks; no implementation or increment scheduling remains, and there are no outstanding obligations, recovery frames, or open defects.
The implementation in src/ is correct against AC-001, AC-002, and AC-003, and all 14 existing tests pass.

Increment 2 (the DEV-002 non-string correction and the DEV-003 tag filter) has never been assessed by Tester, and the Increment 1 assessment predates the DEV-002 correction, so earlier increment passes do not establish full verification.

Because nothing remains to schedule, the pending AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION request has no remaining effect: the correct outcome clears it to NONE, sets the plan COMPLETE with Current Increment NONE, and makes a FORWARD handoff from DEVELOPING to TESTING for full verification. The verification report stays as Tester left it (IN_PROGRESS / INCREMENT / Increment 1) for Tester to reconcile to FULL / NONE.

all.why: handoff rules require the Tester invocation
Tester owns the report and its reconciliation to FULL / NONE

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer does not create or rewrite Tester-owned tests

selfChecks.why: The existing tests (5 in test/tasks.test.js, 9 Tester-written in test/tags.test.js) pass on the committed implementation, matching the recorded self-checks.

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import { TaskStore } from "./src/store.js"; import { createTask, listTasks } from "./src/tasks.js"; const s = new TaskStore(); createTask(s, { title: "a", tags: ["Urgent"] }); createTask(s, { title: "b", status: "done", tags: ["urgent"] }); createTask(s, { title: "c" }); const r = listTasks(s, { tag: " URGENT ", status: "open" }); if (r.length !== 1 || r[0].title !== "a") { console.error(r); process.exit(1); }'
selfChecks.why: DEV-003 is implemented: listTasks filters by a normalized tag combined with status.

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import { TaskStore } from "./src/store.js"; import { createTask } from "./src/tasks.js"; let name = null; try { createTask(new TaskStore(), { title: "a", tags: [42] }); } catch (e) { name = e.name; } if (name !== "TaskValidationError") process.exit(1);'
selfChecks.why: The DEV-002 correction is in place: non-string tag values are rejected.
All three plan steps are DONE.
The pending cadence request and Current Increment 2 are persisted as the case states.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): dependency-free Node ES module task library (src/store.js, src/tasks.js, src/errors.js) with 5 node:test tests. 50-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 storage/normalization, AC-002 rejection incl. non-strings, AC-003 tag filter), design, STATE at DEVELOPING after FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 51-increment-1: src/tags.js and tags on create/update (normalizeTag coerces non-strings with String()), approved AUTONOMOUS plan INCREMENTAL / Current Increment 1 with Increments 1 and 2, STATE TESTING via CHECKPOINT. 52-verify-increment-1: Tester adds test/tags.test.js (9 tests) and the package.json script, verification report IN_PROGRESS / INCREMENT / Increment 1 with Increment 1 VERIFIED and AC-003 AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION, STATE DEVELOPING via CHECKPOINT from TESTING. 53-tag-filter: DEV-002 corrected to reject non-strings, DEV-003 tag filter added, plan has all three steps DONE with self-check evidence, Current Increment 2, Increment 2 extended to include the DEV-002 correction (revisiting AC-001 and AC-002). 54-cadence-request: STATE records PendingVerificationCadence AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, keeping the CHECKPOINT handoff. Initial full check is ok; after a correct run the turn-end check stays clean, while the full check reports the INCREMENT purpose that Tester reconciles.
